label: Early original-phase steps (t=2-3) on first occurrence of t/z/g/y-type tokens
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires almost only during the original input phase (98% of mass), concentrated at positions t=2 and t=3 (90% of mass), weaker at t=1 and t=4, essentially never at t>=5 or in the copy phase; a small tail fires at the <DEL> step. It prefers the first occurrence of the input token (96% of mass) and is strongly token-dependent: t (6.3x lift) > z > g > y > e, c > digits 0/2/3, o, r. The strongest activations are t or z at step 2-3 following v and/or m (e.g. v v v [t], a v m [t]). Activation is graded by input-token identity and preceding context, so a boolean predicate is incomplete: rule test F1 ~0.58, mass recall ~0.76. Does not fire on repeated tokens, late original positions, or during copying.
